description: Ethiopia - Hotspot Priority Woredas is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Ethiopia. This table has priority woredas in three categories (priority 1, 2 and 3) by different sectors (Health, Nutrition, WASH, Agriculture, Market, Education, Child Protection & GBV and others). Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Ethiopia. Its tags are education, logistics. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-04-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
